<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex44012024-1114"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4028">blo brtan</rs> nas bzung <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">nam mkha</rs>'i mtshan can dang || 
            blo gros shes bya kun la dpag <lb n="1b4"/> med rgyas || <!--TOCHECK bzang po needs APIS ref-->
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">bzang po</rs>'i mtshan can <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4016">kho'o</rs>'i yongs 'dzin dang || 
            brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal nas ||
            <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3761">chos mngon mdzod</rs> la sbyor Tig cung zad tsam || <!--TOCHECK bdag needs APIS ref; is this rin chen bzang po (2) (5770?)-->
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:">bdag</rs> gi 'di dag brtsam par <lb n="1b5"/> mi nus na'ang || 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4007">mchims ston bla ma</rs>'i bzhed pa ji bzhin dang || 
            gsung las byon cing TI kar ma thebs rnams || 
            legs par bshad kyi blo gros ldan pa dag | 
            rnam dpyod byed cing ngo gdong bshad 'di ltos te 
            <lb n="1b6"/> sbyor ba dang | rtsod spong dang |
            lung 'dren rnaMs mangs na <abbr>yi ge</abbr> mangs pas 'jigs pas ¦ 
            cung zad bsdus te bshad par bya'o || </seg></TEI>
